critical_code_review_comments: Minor: STATUS_CHIP only maps paid/pending/failed/cancelled — any future status (e.g. 'refunded') falls back to neutral gray, which is fine but worth extending as statuses grow.

Minor: per-payment-row key uses `${p.method}-${i}` — safe, but method='—' for uncategorised is a user-facing em-dash; consider a clearer label like 'Uncategorised' for the UI while keeping raw value in exports.
